'''Valss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]].

==History==
[[File:Valss_on_Copero.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Valss on Copero]]
Valss was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], which in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] meant either exile or restraint from using the powers under penalty of death. Valss however was adopted by [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] into the [[Inrokini family]], who sheltered him on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] where he continued to practice his skills. In [[3629 BBY]] Zenta harbored a fugitive from the [[Eternal Alliance]] named [[Theron Shan]] on Copero and Valss joined Shan's cause, having experienced a vision of his victory. Together, they stole from Zenta the location of a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] leading to a superweapon of the Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] and traveled to it. Shan destroyed the holomap after learning the superweapon's location, but as they prepared to leave, [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] and [[Raina Temple]] arrived to stop them. Valss stayed behind to buy Shan enough time to escape, and was eventually struck down.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Valss appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion as the final boss during the flashpoint "A Traitor Among the Chiss".
